structured.answer: I'd pick the third option. It has fewer numbers, the frightening "מניות עד 120%" line is gone, and the sentence at the bottom explains that the 120% is only a ceiling. But it's all shares and English letters, nothing for me. On my own I would have left after the first screen.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the heading קרנות סל and the English letters S&P, MSCI
stuck.why: I saw immediately that this isn't deposits or anything safe, and I nearly left
More than 100% sounds like risking more than all the money. That scared me

stuck.where: Screen 2, the line 'פרופיל 4A: מניות עד 120%, מט"ח עד 10%'
stuck.why: It's long and small, has English letters, and nothing at the bottom explains what 4A is

used: The fund names and 'עוקבת אחרי מדד ...'
The column חשיפה מרבית / חשיפה מרבית למט"ח
The sentence 'כל הקרנות כאן לא מחלקות...'
The sentence 'החשיפה המרבית היא התקרה... לא מה שהיא מחזיקה היום'
skimmed: The line 'רק הקרנות שהאתר אסף עליהן דוח...'
The tags עסקת החלף, חשיפה לדולר, מס גם על שינויי המטבע

The נאמן line in the fees
not_found: Anything about safety or a deposit
An explanation of what I'd pay in total in fees
An explanation of 4A/4D on the second screen

findings.what: 'מניות עד 120%' is frightening and unclear. It sounds like more than all the money
The page opens with קרנות סל and English letters, with nothing saying what is safe
A long, small line with 'פרופיל 4A/4D' and no explanation at the bottom
Fees split into three (קבוע, משתנה, נאמן) with no total and no explanation
Black background with grey text tires the eyes
findings.where: All the screens, especially the sentences at the bottom

findings.what: 'מס גם על שינויי המטבע' worries me and isn't explained
findings.where: Tags under the foreign fund names
